summary: Diverse-adapter pairwise SET tournament, champion floor
hypothesis: Running a pairwise relative tournament across four fine-tuned adapters (v2a/v2b variants) should surface the best question set by direct head-to-head comparison, with a champion-floor fallback ensuring a quality baseline is always met.
technique: Four adapter variants (v2a/v2b) each generate a candidate question set verbatim; a pairwise relative SET tournament (model-based) compares candidates head-to-head to crown a champion, with a deterministic champion-floor post-processing step as a safety net.
result: Scored 0.380 on the full-30 gate (1 win / 4 ties / 24 losses vs Sonnet); rubric showed atomicity and naturalness at 4 but spec and coverage both at 3, meaning diversity across adapters did not unlock the coverage gains hoped for. Discarded — below the bar for a new best.
